from common import *
from objective import *
from itertools import combinations
from scipy.stats import spearmanr

def main():
    rng=np.random.default_rng(1341);days=pd.bdate_range('2019-11-01',periods=20);n=29
    idx=pd.MultiIndex.from_product([days,range(n)],names=['datetime','instrument']);y=rng.normal(size=len(idx));score=rng.normal(0,.5,len(idx))
    grade=np.array(pd.Series(y,index=idx).groupby(level=0).rank(pct=True)*10).astype(int).clip(0,9)-4.5
    weights=np.repeat(np.arange(1,len(days)+1),n);g=RegretGradient(idx,grade,y,weights)
    def reward(z,p):
        # independent scalar reference: sort strict top-three values and average, same under ties.
        return np.sort(z)[-3:].mean()
    def loss(s):
        out=0
        for j,(l,h,*_) in enumerate(g.windows):
            x=s[l:h];z=g.z[l:h];winner=np.argsort(z)[-3:];spo=reward(2*x-z,None)-2*x[winner].mean()+z[winner].mean()
            out+=(.5*np.square(x-grade[l:h]).sum()+.25*np.sqrt(3*n)*spo)*weights[l]
        return out
    direction=rng.normal(size=len(y));step=1e-6;grad,hes=g(score,None)
    assert np.isclose((loss(score+step*direction)-loss(score-step*direction))/(2*step),grad@direction,rtol=2e-6)
    assert np.array_equal(hes,weights)
    own=np.array([i%4==0 for i in range(len(days))]);ctx=pd.DataFrame(dict(own=np.repeat(own,n),prev=np.repeat(np.maximum(np.arange(len(days))-5,-1),n),tradable=True,raw=y),index=idx)
    df=pd.DataFrame({('label','LABEL0'):grade},index=idx)
    m=MixedMetric(df,ctx,g.scale)
    scores=score.copy().reshape(-1,n);scores[:,0:6]=5
    a=m.compute(scores.ravel());reverse=m.compute(scores.ravel(),True)
    comb=list(combinations(range(6),3))
    ret=np.mean([np.mean(y.reshape(-1,n)[own][:,list(c)],axis=1) for c in comb])
    turnover=np.mean([1.-len(set(c)&set(d))/3 for c in comb for d in comb])
    meanic=np.mean([spearmanr(scores[k],grade.reshape(-1,n)[k]).statistic for k in np.flatnonzero(own)])
    assert abs(a['turnover']-turnover)<1e-12 and abs(a['gross_h5']-ret)<1e-12 and abs(meanic-a['ic'])<1e-12 and abs(a['mixed']-reverse['mixed'])<1e-12
    assert np.isclose(a['mixed'],.8*meanic+.2*(ret-.00092*turnover)/g.scale)
    ww=members(np.array([5,4,3,3,3,2,1]));assert np.allclose(ww[1],[1,1,1/3,1/3,1/3])
    write(BASE/'docs/preflight.json',dict(directional_derivative_ok=True,true_mse_hessian=True,exact_enumeration_test=True,expected_turnover=turnover,reverse_delta=abs(a['mixed']-reverse['mixed']),rankic_reference=meanic))
if __name__=='__main__':main()
